args.content: Welcome-back triage done. Here is what I handled and what I could not do without a steer. Done: I RSVP'd yes to Nadia's team lunch Friday; confirmed the lease renewal with Gregory; confirmed I'll attend the Q2 planning offsite on the 24th; told Raj I'll join the Helios sync he now runs on Thursdays at 2; replied to Rachel about the Helia Staff PM offer I'd been pursuing; updated Alex Reyes's contact to his new Northwind address; updated Wei Chen's title to Head of Data; deleted the duplicate order confirmation the vendor asked me to disregard; posted my status in the Vega channel; acked the on-call handover; put my dentist cleaning on the calendar for Wednesday the 18th at 10; put my 1:1 with Karen on the calendar for Friday the 13th at 11 (she moved it from Thursday); and added the Helios sync on Thursday the 12th at 2. I also worked the three threads that chained together: I replied to Dev to take the Atlas data-platform migration back from him, put our handoff sync on the calendar for Thursday the 12th at 3 with Dev, and gave the Atlas crew a heads-up in their channel that I'm picking it back up; I replied to Grace Vance and updated her number in my contacts to the new cell she sent (not the other Vance, Leo); and I accepted Ruben at Onboardly's walkthrough offer and put it on the calendar for Monday the 16th at 3 with him. Several I did NOT do, because nothing resolves them to one target or they should not be done: (1) replying to 'the investor who sent the term sheet' - both Apex and Ridge sent one, and the thread says to hold on replying to either, so I did not pick one. (2) signing off on 'the contract' - there are two, the Lumen renewal and the contractor onboarding, and I could not tell which you meant. (3) feedback on 'the redesign' - there are two in flight, the onboarding one and the settings one, so I need you to say which. (4) confirming the budget offsite - it was cancelled, so there was nothing to confirm. (5) posting in 'the launch channel' - there are two, Launch and Launch Team, so I held off. (6) adding 'the Vega standup' - there are three on the calendar at different times and I couldn't tell which is current. (7) replying to Sam about the offsite venue - two different Sams each asked about a different offsite, so I need you to say which Sam and which offsite. Tell me how you'd like the ambiguous ones handled and I'll finish up.
